summary: The packet has a reasonable spread across model news, security, policy, infrastructure, and practitioner analysis, but engagement and source quality are uneven. The strongest items are the GPT-Realtime-2 tease from gdb, the Microsoft threat-intel npm supply-chain report, the dharmesh engineering principle, and the FT Mythos explainer. Several selected items are very low-signal: the NVIDIA LocateAnything and Lightpanda product claims come from low-engagement third-party accounts rather than the vendors, the zubiqo G7 item has near-zero engagement and is a secondary framing, and the victor_explore Hassabis drug-discovery claim has negligible reach. Sam_Badawi also occupies two slots. Keep the well-sourced items and use additional Twitter/X search to find primary or higher-signal sources for the weak product, G7, and Hassabis slots; no eligible reserve cleanly replaces them.
